name: Koz
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Koz (also spelled Hakos or Koz) is mentioned in the Bible as a person linked to priestly families after the exile. His descendants were among those who could not prove their priestly lineage when the Israelites returned from Babylon. The name also appears in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Koz is mentioned as part of Judah's lineage in 1 Chronicles, where his descendants are listed.

keyEvents.title: Priestly service of the descendants
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Koz (the sons of Hakos) were among the priestly families that returned from exile in Babylon but had difficulty proving their priestly ancestry.

keyEvents.title: Division of the priesthood
keyEvents.description: Hakos is mentioned as the seventh of the 24 priestly divisions established under David, according to 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Meremoth, son of Uriah, son of Hakkoz
keyEvents.description: Meremoth, a descendant of Kos (Hakkoz), participated in the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership.

keyEvents.title: Priestly Families in the Time of Nehemiah
keyEvents.description: Descendants of Hakkoz are mentioned again in connection with those who could not find their family records among the priests in the time of Nehemiah.
